# Real advisory snapshots used only by tests

These JSON files were fetched from GitHub's public Global Security Advisories REST API on 2026-09-23 using the allowlisted importer. They preserve original content and update dates. They are not imported into the application bundle and are never a runtime research fallback.

Refresh with npm run ingest, review the source changes, and copy the reviewed data/raw JSON snapshots here. Source URLs and timestamps are inside each file. The tests deliberately distinguish these real records from mocked model/MCP transports and the opt-in live Sanity test.
